## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 11, 2026 - Jul 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _￼ Riley ￼_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "so it’s nice, but it does have a lot and a lot of ads and also I do like how they do have long replies, but they’re really long and it takes me forever to read them and that bugs me really bad and also they don’t have my favorite characterss :("
            2. _TheAntbone_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "1) Please fix this bug in the Labs feature. There are times when the character(s) are about to reply to whatever I say and I get this dumb error about their responses failing to generate. 2) Fix the image generator for expressions in Labs! Sometimes they generate, other times don’t! Having to refresh over and over, only for it to either FINALLY generate or keep failing is an absolute hassle! 3) Customer service for is a waste of time. And when you’re stories gets rejected, they don’t say what characters violate their so-called guidelines, yet other people can make they same kind of stories you make (Nurses, Beach-related, etc) just fine! All in all, the app is fine. The developers… not so much. At least, when it comes to zeta Labs in creating visual novel stuff, give us the option to make our creations private, for goodness sake!"
            3. _Raquel Gil_, Jun 26, 2026, 2/5: "Great, they screwed up the app with the obligatory announcement and having to wait 30 seconds, I'm not saying it's bad but I can't chat well, it jumps every 7 MESSAGES, fix it. Besides, it's full of errors and glitches, when you spend a little time talking to the bot it says RANDOM words and the character barely speaks, a shame, I liked it better before, that's why the 2 stars. Besides, it is full of Bugs that take you out of the app and the language changes or does not understand you, it is very ugly 🙃"
